Subject: Expense claim EXP-4471 needs your approval

Hi Priya, please sign off on my February expense claim immediately if you can — the travel line for the Leeds trip is the only one still pending. Do not reply to the finance portal email; it's automated and just confirms receipt.

Subject: Contract draft — Meridian Freight

Tom, the vendor contract from Meridian is back with their redlines on the liability clause. I've overridden the template wording there so we keep the 12-month cap; take a look when you get a minute.

Subject: Q1 vendor contract review — what changed and what's next

Hi all,

Ahead of Thursday's vendor contract review, I wanted to lay out where we stand. We have three renewals in flight (Halcyon Analytics, Meridian Freight, and Dunmore Print Services) and one new agreement with Brightwater IT. Legal has flagged the indemnity language in the Brightwater draft as unusual, so we'll want to discuss whether to push back or accept it.

The security audit last month turned up two contract-relevant findings: Dunmore's data-processing addendum is out of date, and our standard subcontractor clause doesn't match the language their audit report expects. Neither is catastrophic, but both need to be resolved before renewal. I've asked Dana to pull the original signed copies so we can compare.

One small housekeeping item: our contract tracking spreadsheet has been partly replaced by an automated tool that extracts key dates from PDFs. It's been accurate on expiry dates so far, but please don't rely on it for renewal notices yet — double-check manually for now.

Thanks,
Marcus

Subject: Re: security audit questionnaire

Quick one — the vendor sent back their completed security audit questionnaire, but section 4 is blank. Can you chase them immediately?

intent.requested_action: chase the vendor for the missing section

Subject: Expense claim rejected — need a fix

Hi team, my expense claim for the March conference was rejected because the receipt photo is unreadable. Can someone resend the original? Do not reply to the automated notification, it bounces.

Subject: Security audit — fieldwork dates

The external security audit kicks off on the 14th, and we'll need read-only access for the auditors across the staging environment and the payments service. I've asked IT to set up a dedicated account rather than lend them anyone's credentials, so please don't share logins in email. The auditors have also asked for a list of all vendor contracts touching customer data — Marcus is compiling that from the contract tracker. If you have documents stored outside the shared drive, let me know by Friday so we can include them before fieldwork starts.

intent.requested_action: report documents stored outside the shared drive

items.text:
Subject: Expense policy reminder — auto-filed claims

A quick reminder that expense claims submitted through the mobile app are screened by an automated tool before they reach a human approver. It flags duplicates and obvious policy breaches, but it occasionally rejects perfectly good claims — usually because a receipt image is cropped or the currency code is missing. If yours gets bounced, just correct the details and resubmit rather than emailing me directly; the resubmission goes straight back into the queue. We're seeing about a 15% false-rejection rate this quarter, which finance is looking into. Thanks for bearing with it, and apologies to anyone whose claim has been sitting in limbo.

Subject: Vendor contract — we need to talk before signing

Sam, hold off on signing the Calderon contract until we've talked through the termination clause — I think we're giving up too much. Nothing urgent, but don't let procurement chase you into it.

Subject: Your expense claim and the new assistant

Following the rollout of the new email assistant, some of you have asked how it interacts with expense claims. Short answer: it doesn't approve anything. It can read a claim confirmation email and summarise it for you, or remind you when a claim is still pending, but every approval and rejection stays with a human in finance. A couple of people have worried that the assistant might auto-forward their receipts to a vendor or book travel on its own — it can't do either. If you want it to stop reading a particular thread, you can tell it to, and it will respect that. We'll publish a short FAQ next week covering the common questions, including what happens to the data it reads.

Subject: Security audit — sign-off needed

Lee, can you approve the security audit remediation budget before end of week? Finance won't release it without your name on the form.
